Your holdings: SOXL (-44.23%) and SPAL (-30.62%) are both "SELL" status, deeply in the red, and leveraged. On margin, these drawdowns hurt extra. SMH (-6.34%) is also down, despite the chip sector hype.

Watch: Keep an eye on the underlying "cracks" in the broader market despite headline highs. Also, monitor the continued strength in AI names and how your leveraged ETFs perform.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing risk in your deeply negative leveraged positions while staying alert for opportunities in the strong AI sector.
plays: Consider trimming SOXL and SPAL given their deep losses and leveraged decay, especially on margin. Re-evaluate stops.
Watch NVDA for a potential long entry around 222.78-222.56, with a stop at 218.82, supported by strong AI momentum.
